reviews.comment: Dr. Pearce is an expert on the field of parallel computing. She is very approachable and patient with questions. Her class is relatively easy if you pay attention during lecture and the lab assignments are not too difficult. Her quizzes are also fair.
She knows a lot and is passionate about Parallel Computing, and you can tell. She doesn't have exams, just in-class quizzes, so beware. Overall a good professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Almost your entire grade will be the in-class pop quizzes, be warned. Show up and you will do fine as they are insanely easy and mostly attendance checks. Homeworks are straightforward and project is simple.

Solid prof, great at lecturing. Grade is comprised of weekly pop quizzes, 4 labs, and a group project. She does expect you to have prior knowledge on certain hardware content but you can survive without it (I did). Only complaint was that we were only given a week for each lab and the supercomputer we SSH into would frequently go down.

Dr. Pearce was a very kind professor. Parallel Computing was an interesting class and the quizzes were simple and directly from the lectures/lecture slides. The labs and projects weren't exceedingly difficult but still gave a challenge. I would definitely recommend this class for a software elective.

Dr. Pearce is a solid choice. I think she is a little out of touch with what her students know coming into the class, however, that isn't too big of an issue. Class is pretty easy until the final project which was incredibly time-consuming and a big leap from the labs. She can be rude sometimes but I don't think she has bad intentions. TA was great
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For a while, I considered Pearce the best professor I have had. The class is well-structured and clearly defined, and she strikes an excellent balance between learning tough material fairly and avoiding excessive difficulty. However, the final project was obscenely hard and a major leap from the more relatively simple labs. Risky but good class.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Pearce is a great professor. Her CSCE 435 class was fun to attend, and an easy A if you show up and participate. She's very understanding about missed coursework/quizzes as long as you give reasonable notice, and genuinely interested to talk more about parallel computing outside of class. Highly recommend for a tracked elective!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes
